listing.name: inFAMOUS Second Son — inFAMOUS-Second-Son-PC-Edition (kam0n4ik)
listing.summary: Upstream reports playable city gameplay, saves and 46–51 FPS on one PC; lower frame times and experimental presets are measured separately. Full-game completion and hardware breadth are not established by this pass. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own decrypted CUSA00004 update 01.07 directory containing eboot.bin, sce_module, sce_sys and art (about 30 GB). Upstream explicitly requires no PS4 firmware files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README offers SecondSonPC-win64.zip. Extract beside owned eboot.bin and run play.cmd; first launch compiles shaders, not the game CPU executable. Alternative build.ps1 uses LLVM 20+, CMake/Ninja and Visual Studio headers/SDK, with pinned shadPS4 source patches. Saves stay in userdata and are backed up by play.cmd.

warnings: Upstream reports playable city gameplay, saves and 46–51 FPS on one PC; lower frame times and experimental presets are measured separately. Full-game completion and hardware breadth are not established by this pass.
Experimental discovery listing. Setup, gameplay, saves and updates have not been qualified by Portcove.
